content.text: No MFN mechanic exists anywhere in the agreement; the only pricing obligation on Sparkling is payment per the Fee Schedule.

input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: We searched the fees clause (§11), the maintenance/support pricing terms (§10 and the Software Repair Service fee provisions), and General Matters (§20 and its continuation), plus targeted searches for most-favoured-nation, "no less favourable", best/preferential pricing, third-party offers, and match/right-to-match language. There is no MFN, best-terms, or price-matching mechanic anywhere in the Agreement, and nothing obliging Sparkling to extend Garman terms given to any third party. Sparkling's only pricing obligation is to pay the fees set out in the Fee Schedule. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation burdening Customer), so no redline is warranted; equally, there is no Vendor-granted MFN in our favour to preserve.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
mappings.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
